basis: PING WebFit / PING public fitting guidance inspired decision-support model; not a reproduction of proprietary PING algorithms.
principles: Use available launch-monitor data; unknown fields remain optional.
Optimize launch and spin together rather than shaft flex alone.
Slower speed generally benefits from more loft and/or lighter, softer, higher-launch builds; faster speed may fit lower loft and firmer, lower-launch builds.
Head model recommendation must consider dispersion and miss direction, not only distance.
Recommend a controlled next test rather than claiming a definitive fit from incomplete data.

useWhen: excess spin after strike quality check

HL.intent: lighter total build / higher launch / speed assistance

guardrails: Do not prescribe a shaft flex solely from club speed.
Do not treat one shot as a fitting session.
Check strike location before interpreting spin extremes.
